messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — spotted multiple issues in the Python quickstart docs while onboarding a customer. Auth snippet no longer matches the SDK (docs show `Client(api_key=...)` but current Client ctor expects `api_key_id` + `api_key_secret`). Also the async example is missing an `await` and the sample-app link 404s: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/python/sample-app

henry: omg thanks. do you have the exact snippet? can paste a minimal repro?

maria: yep pasted the snippet I found in the docs below:

```python
from redwood import Client

# docs example (stale)
client = Client(api_key="sk-xxxx")
resp = client.generate("hello")
print(resp.text)
```

This fails with TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'api_key' in 0.8.1

sasha: that explains the auth errors new users see. SDK now uses split creds because of KMS rotation support — we updated ctor in 0.7 -> 0.8 but docs not updated.

jamie: quick fix options: 1) revert docs to show current pattern, 2) add a compatibility note and short shim example, 3) add a doctest to prevent drift. I can open a tiny PR. :+1:

maria: thanks. also the async sample shows:
```python
async def main():
    client = Client(api_key="sk-xxxx")
    stream = await client.chat.stream("hi")
    async for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk)
# no await client.aclose() in example
```
That leaks background tasks on recent aiohttp versions and tests on latest pyflakes catch it.

henry: ugh. are we tracking which docs pages are most critical? sample-app link 404 will block onboarding flows. I tried the link and got 404 at the docs site too.

marco: buildbot (docs) actually failed yesterday for the site deploy, looks related. logs: 
```
ERROR: failed to fetch /quickstart/python/sample-app -> 404 (file not found)
WARN: broken link: /quickstart/python#async-usage
```
This is why link checks are helpful.

jamie: I'll open a PR that: updates the auth snippet to `Client(api_key_id="id", api_key_secret="secret")`, fixes async example to await `client.aclose()` and adds a link redirect to the sample-app repo. also add a quick unit-ish doctest so CI flags snippet breakage.

sasha: please add a typing note too — the current stub for `Client.generate` is missing `-> GenerationResponse` and makes mypy unhappy. small change but high DX value.

maria: agreed. small checklist in PR description would be great: docs page, sample-app redirect, doctest, typing fix.

docs-bot: docs-bot noticed new issue #4127 created by jamie: "quickstart python: auth/async/snippet drift + broken sample-app link" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4127

henry: awesome, thanks everyone. if we can get a fast patch and a redirect, should be smooth. can someone volunteer to shepherd the docs deploy after PR merges?

marco: I'll run the post-merge deploy and watch the link checker.

jamie: PR up in a few mins, ping me for review.

maria: thanks all :rocket:
